finalText:
**Green now. All 625 tests pass.**

Only 3 cases were really broken. All in `order totals`.

`orderTotal` took the discount off, then taxed the **full** price. Tax should ride on what the customer actually pays. Rows with a zero discount or zero tax hid it.

The fix in `src/pricing.js` is one line:

```js
const discounted = applyDiscount(cents, discountPct);
return applyTax(discounted, taxRate);
```

`verify.js` also passes.
